projects.title: Siena Information Retrieval Assistant (SIRA)
projects.description:
SIRA was designed to parse previous user search queries organized in an XML file and help frame a future search based on what we assume they want to see according to past searches.

The focus of our research was to approach the problem keeping in mind what the typical search behaviors of your average user was, with the main hypothesis being that a user could decided if a page was helpful or not in the first 'N%' of the page.

This system was written from scratch in Java and uses the JSoup library to parse the XML file.
